_note: Planning ratios used by the estimates. Example values from published UK guidance as reproduced by local authorities; check what your licensing authority expects.

planning_density_ppm2.source: 0.5 m² per standing person is the common UK planning figure for event capacity; seated ≈ 0.7 m² per seat including aisles (assumption)

exit_width_mm_per_person.source: IBC 2021 §1005.3.2 egress width 0.2 in (5.1 mm) per occupant (example rule)

stewards.source: Green Guide practice: about 1 steward per 250 people, rising to 1 per 100 where alcohol or children raise the risk (as summarised by Lichfield District Council)

first_aid.source: Purple Guide based guidance: at least 2 first aiders, plus 2 per additional 1,000 attendees (UK Athletics)

toilets.source: Purple Guide sanitation table (50:50 audience) as reproduced by Aberdeen City Council and Dover District Council; 1 hand-wash unit per 5 toilets (Aberdeen)

front_barrier_wing_m.source: Front-of-stage barrier extends past each side of the stage (assumption: 3 m per side)

unit_costs_example.source: Example unit prices for budgeting only; replace them with your local quotes in Settings

egress_capacity.source: Green Guide method: exit capacity = open exit width × flow rate × egress time (flow 1.3 people per metre per second ≈ 78 per minute, close to the Green Guide's 82 for level routes; stairs 1.0); egress time 8 min open-air, 5 min indoors
